options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful in work zones. A flagger ahead will direct traffic. Follow their instructions.

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.

Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange work area signs show an alternate route to avoid a blocked road. Follow the detour as directed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to change your route to avoid the work zone ahead. Follow the detour signs.

questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign means workers are on or near the road. Drive very carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people entering the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that vehicles from the right lane are joining your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you an intersection is coming up. Look carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is limited in this area. You can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must always wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield to other traffic. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert you to hazards or unusual conditions ahead.

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way on a one-way street. This creates a serious risk of a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.
